statement: ∀ (s t : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), (KdVPlan.MemH s (KdVPlan.S t f) ↔ KdVPlan.MemH s f) ∧ KdVPlan.hn s (KdVPlan.S t f) = KdVPlan.hn s f ∧ (KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean (KdVPlan.S t f))
proof:
intro s t f
have hnrm : ∀ k : ℤ, ‖KdVPlan.S t f k‖ = ‖f k‖ := by
  intro k
  change ‖Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((t * (k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ) : ℂ)) * f k‖ = _
  rw [norm_mul, mul_comm Complex.I, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· simp only [KdVPlan.MemH, hnrm]
· simp only [KdVPlan.hn, hnrm]
· intro hf
  simpa [KdVPlan.ZeroMean, KdVPlan.S] using hf
